verdict.rationale: LangSmith's evaluation docs list "Code rules" as a first-party evaluator type for scoring performance, alongside LLM-as-judge and pairwise comparison. Online evaluators also run code-style checks such as format validation and quality heuristics on production traces. The evidence is only a bullet-list mention, so how deep custom scorers and metrics go is unproven. Missing for 10: SDK or API docs showing how to write a custom evaluator function, details on custom metric or score types and return formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations

citations.quote: Create evaluators to score performance: Human review, Code rules, LLM-as-judge, Pairwise comparison
Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces: safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge.
